scope: Token usage rules for workflow/stage tokens (T*/B*/ET*) across IDs, fields, and text

rules.title: Workflow tokens must not be embedded into canonical entity IDs
must: Entity IDs (e.g., ItemID, NPCID, QuestID, ChunkID, etc.) MUST be stable and MUST NOT include workflow/stage tokens (T*, B*, ET*).
If a workflow token appears inside an entity ID, classify as HIGH risk and resolve via alias mapping + controlled migration.

rules.title: ETID is the canonical place for T/B tokens
must: Use ETID field to store stage identifiers (T#.B#.[#]...) in canonical dot form.
Underscore/hyphen variants are treated as aliases only (see CORE/ALIASES_ID.csv).

rules.title: Textual references are allowed but should be normalized
should: In Titles/Descriptions, prefer canonical dot form for stage tokens (T#.B#.[#]...).
If legacy underscores exist in text, they may remain but must be covered by ALIASES_ID mappings.

rules.title: Audit is mandatory before any migration
must: Before renaming any canonical IDs, generate/update ID_TOKEN_AUDIT.csv and ALIASES_ID.csv.
Migration steps must be executed in their own AJ with explicit acceptance criteria.
